title: Comprehensive ETP Chemical, Biological, and Crystallized Salt Sludge Handling & Management

data.Characteristics: High inorganic content (Alum/Lime/PAC hydroxides), dark color, high heavy metal content, solids conc 2-4%.
data.Dewatering Method: Filter Press / Decanter Centrifuge (dewatered to 30-35% dry solids cake)
data.Disposal Method: Disposal at Authorized Hazardous Waste TSDF (Treatment, Storage & Disposal Facility) Secured Landfill
data.Reuse Options: Co-processing in Cement Kilns (if heavy metals meet coprocessing criteria)
data.Storage Requirements: Covered concrete shed with leachate collection pit and impervious HDPE lining
data.Handling Procedures: Operators must wear rubber gloves, dust masks, and gumboots. Transport in closed containers with Form 10 Manifest.

data.Sludge Type: Secondary Biological Sludge (Waste Activated Sludge - WAS)
data.Characteristics: Organic biomass sludge, rich in nitrogen & phosphorus, high moisture (98.5-99%), dark brown odor-free.
data.Dewatering Method: Sludge Drying Beds / Rotary Drum Thickener -> Filter Press (dewatered to 20-25% solids)
data.Disposal Method: Solar Sludge Drying -> Composting / Authorized TSDF incinerator
data.Reuse Options: Bio-fertilizer for non-food crops / Soil conditioner after heavy metal testing
data.Storage Requirements: Ventilated bio-sludge holding tank with coarse bubble aeration to prevent septic odor
data.Handling Procedures: Pump WAS daily based on MCRT (10-12 days); avoid septic stagnation in clarifier hoppers.

data.Characteristics: Ferric Hydroxide Fe(OH)3 precipitate, dense red-brown color, acidic origin, solids conc 3-5%.
data.Dewatering Method: Recessed Plate High-Pressure Filter Press (dewatered to 35-40% solids)
data.Reuse Options: Inorganic pigment manufacturing / Iron recovery raw material
data.Storage Requirements: Dedicated Hazardous Waste Shed labeled as per CPCB Form 8
data.Handling Procedures: Neutralize sludge slurry to pH 7.5-8.0 prior to filter press pumping.

data.Source Unit: Agitated Thin Film Dryer (ATFD) & MEE Crystallizer
data.Characteristics: Dry crystalline salt powder (NaCl 70-80%, Na2SO4 15-25%), white/off-white powder, moisture < 2%, TDS 99.5%.
data.Dewatering Method: Thermal Drying via ATFD Steam Jacket (Moisture < 2%)
data.Disposal Method: Authorized TSDF Hazardous Landfill OR Marine Discharge (where permitted)
data.Reuse Options: Refined Salt Washing System for Textile Process Dyeing Bath Reuse
data.Storage Requirements: Dry moisture-proof sealed HDPE bags stored on wooden pallets in enclosed dry warehouse
data.Handling Procedures: Automatic bagging machine; operators wear N95 dust masks and eye goggles.
